queue_policy.name: first_static_triage_queue
queue_policy.promotion_policy: static_verified requires later authorized static triage evidence; runtime_validated requires later authorized runtime validation

queued_items.why_selected: First inventory_only cpp representative listed in the current string_comparison coverage row; selection is a queue seed only, not evidence that this sample is a verified string compare target.
required_static_evidence: Identify compare function or inline compare that gates success/failure branch.
Record compare callsite address and operand source from static analysis.
Identify compared value or producer function from static decompilation or string extraction.
queued_items.promotion_rule: May advance beyond metadata_only only after a later authorized static triage artifact identifies compare callsite, operand source, and compared value or producer.
queued_items.stop_condition: Keep metadata_only if static triage does not identify a concrete compare gate.

queued_items.why_selected: First current XOR row sample id; it is queued to audit the solver/support metadata gap and must not be treated as target proof or static evidence.
required_static_evidence: Identify XOR instruction or XOR loop operating on input or derived data.
Identify XOR key or key derivation from static analysis.
Determine loop bounds and operand width from static analysis.
queued_items.promotion_rule: May advance only after later authorized static evidence identifies a target XOR operation, key material, and loop structure; solver script naming alone never promotes confidence.
queued_items.stop_condition: If the queued id is only support code or metadata, keep the row blocked as gap_or_tool_only and select a concrete target in a later metadata refresh.

queued_items.why_selected: First shift/affine row sample id and PE inventory entry; selected as a later static-only affine/shift evidence profile seed.
required_static_evidence: Identify shift, rotate, or affine transform applied to input bytes.
Extract transform constants such as shift amount, affine multiplier, or affine offset.
Determine transform loop structure and iteration count from static decompilation.
queued_items.promotion_rule: May promote only after static triage identifies transform operations, constants, and loop structure.
queued_items.stop_condition: Keep metadata_level_unverified if constants or transform path are not identified.

queued_items.why_selected: First current lookup_table row id; because tool_evidence_available is false, this item records the table-evidence support gap instead of claiming automated proof readiness.
required_static_evidence: Identify lookup table or array indexing operation used in a transform.
Identify table base address and size from static analysis.
Extract or verify table contents from static analysis.
queued_items.promotion_rule: Do not promote until later authorized static triage or manual static evidence records table access, base/size, and contents.
queued_items.stop_condition: Remain needs_static_triage_field_support_or_manual_static_evidence while lookup-table extraction fields are absent.

queued_items.why_selected: First PE rc4enc target after solver-support scripts in the current RC4 row; selected for a later static cipher profile pass only.
required_static_evidence: Identify RC4 KSA or PRGA loop structure.
Identify RC4 S-box initialization and 256-byte state array.
Identify key material or key derivation from static decompilation or string extraction.
queued_items.promotion_rule: May promote only after static evidence identifies KSA/PRGA, S-box state, and key material.
queued_items.stop_condition: Keep metadata_level_unverified if RC4 structure or key source is not statically identified.

queued_items.why_selected: First PE DES target after solver-support script in the current DES row; selected for later static cipher evidence profiling.
required_static_evidence: Identify DES round function or S-box lookup pattern.
Identify DES key schedule or subkey derivation.
Identify DES permutation tables or constants from static analysis.
queued_items.promotion_rule: May promote only after static evidence identifies DES structure, constants, and key schedule.
queued_items.stop_condition: Keep metadata_level_unverified if DES structure or key schedule is not statically identified.

queued_items.why_selected: Current PE SHA-256 row sample with known blocked training status; selected to preserve the bounded-domain requirement before any solver attempt.
required_static_evidence: Identify hash constants or hash round structure.
Identify or bound input domain including length, charset, or format.
Identify hash comparison point and compared hash value.
queued_items.promotion_rule: May promote only after static triage identifies hash structure, comparison, and bounded input domain; hash constants alone are insufficient.
queued_items.stop_condition: Remain blocked if no bounded input domain evidence is recovered.

queued_items.why_selected: Only current simple_antidebug row sample; selected for static SEH/anti-debug triage only.
required_static_evidence: Identify anti-debug technique such as IsDebuggerPresent, NtQueryInformationProcess, PEB BeingDebugged, INT trap, or SEH-based anti-debug.
Identify anti-debug check location and branch condition from static analysis.
Determine static bypass or patch strategy from decompilation without executing a debugger.
allowed_existing_routes: reverse_agent.olly_scripts.collect_evidence only in a later decision that explicitly authorizes dynamic/debugger work
queued_items.promotion_rule: May promote only after static triage identifies the anti-debug technique, check location, and branch condition.
queued_items.stop_condition: Keep metadata_level_unverified if SEH filename metadata is the only signal.

queued_items.why_selected: First current mixed_unknown PE sample id; selected to define a later one-sample static triage path that can re-tag from observed static evidence.
required_static_evidence: Run static triage in a later authorized round to identify the actual transform type.
Assign at least one concrete transform tag from static evidence when observed.
If no recognized transform is found, document static_triage_completed evidence and keep mixed_unknown.
queued_items.promotion_rule: May re-tag only from later authorized static evidence; unknown category and sample name are insufficient.
queued_items.stop_condition: Remain mixed_unknown if static triage cannot identify a concrete transform type.

blocked_categories.next_allowed_action: Add or identify TEA/XTEA training material in a later metadata-only intake round before static triage planning.
Add metadata/type tagging for Base64 only when a current sample or static evidence observes Base64 constants or transform material.
Add GUI/static UI evidence fields after a current GUI sample is identified; do not plan runtime GUI workflows from empty inventory.

limitations: This artifact is a planning queue and schema artifact, not a solver result.
All queued items remain metadata_only until a later authorized static triage or manual static evidence artifact proves otherwise.
No sample, solver, harness, IDA, Ghidra, debugger, emulator, runtime probe, sidecar, GUI workflow, or full solve_reports scan was run in this round.
Coverage matrix rows can select representatives but cannot prove static verification by filename, category, sample id, solver module name, or metadata alone.
The lookup_table representative records a field-support/manual-evidence gap because tool_evidence_available is false.
The XOR representative may be support-code metadata rather than a concrete target; it is queued only to preserve that gap for a later authorized triage or metadata refresh.
Hash samples require bounded input-domain evidence before any solver or brute-force attempt.
bit_operations is treated only as a secondary/cross-cutting tag in this first queue.
